info.name: Flarize Platform API
info.description:
Every HTTP endpoint of the Flarize backend (generated by docs/postman/_work/build_collection.py — do not edit by hand; see docs/postman/README.md).

Surfaces: `/api/{{api_version}}/` staff (JWT), `/api/public/…` website (anonymous), `/api/agent/…` office agents (service token), `/api/customer/…` customer signed links, `/iclock/…` terminals (flag ADMS_RECEIVER), `/legacy/…` old website contracts (flag LEGACY_API_SHIM), ops.

Run order: 00 Auth (log in) → domain folders (creates store uids in variables) → 98 Cleanup → 99 Sign out. Errors use the envelope `{code, message, errors, error_codes}`.

request.description:
Verifies the credentials and opens a session; returns an RS256 **access** token (15 min, send as `Authorization: Bearer <access>`) and a **refresh** token (rotated on every use; session lasts at most `ACCOUNTS_SESSION_MAX_AGE`, 30 days). Both travel in the JSON body — no cookies. Errors: 401 `invalid_credentials` (wrong e-mail/password, unknown or inactive user — indistinguishable), 403 `password_reset_required` (correct password but the account must set one via the reset/invite link), 429 `login_locked` with `Retry-After` (too many failures per e-mail or IP), 429 throttled. The test script stores `access` → `{{access_token}}` and `refresh` → `{{refresh_token}}`.

**Auth:** `none` — Anonymous: ignores any Authorization header. Throttle scope `login` (10/15min per client IP).

**Body fields:** `email`* string:email; `password`* string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Creates an accounts_user_session row (refresh jti outstanding) and stamps user.last_login_at; Audit `accounts.login` (failures: `accounts.login_failed` / `accounts.login_locked` / `accounts.login_blocked`, counted towards the DB lockout)

**Responses:** 200; 400 `validation_error` — field errors in `errors`.; 401 `invalid_credentials`.; 403 `password_reset_required`.; 429 `login_locked` (Retry-After seconds) or `throttled`.

request.description:
Exchanges the refresh token (JSON body field `refresh`, not a cookie) for a new access + refresh pair; the presented refresh token is blacklisted. The session is re-checked on every refresh. 401 codes: `token_invalid`, `session_revoked`, `session_expired`, `refresh_token_rotated` (an already-rotated token reused inside the grace window — use the latest one), `refresh_token_reused` (replay after the grace window: the session is ended), `user_inactive`; 403 `password_reset_required`. Stores the new pair into `{{access_token}}` / `{{refresh_token}}`.

**Auth:** `none` — Anonymous (an expired access token must not block a refresh); refresh token in the JSON body. Throttle scope `token_refresh` (300/15min per IP).

**Body fields:** `refresh`* string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Blacklists the old refresh jti, rotates session.refresh_jti/expires_at (version bump), bumps the session cache namespace; Replay after the grace window: audit `accounts.refresh_token_reused` + session ended

**Responses:** 200; 400 `validation_error` — field errors in `errors`.; 401 `token_invalid` · `session_revoked` · `session_expired` · `refresh_token_rotated` · `refresh_token_reused` · `user_inactive`.; 403 `password_reset_required` (the session is ended).; 429 `throttled`.

request.description:
Who the caller is and what they may do: the user, their role, the effective `permissions` (`{module: [actions]}`) and record `scopes` (`{module: scope}`) resolved server-side from the role, and the current `session_uid` (from the token's `sid` claim). Open to every signed-in user; no module permission.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` — Any authenticated staff user. Throttle scope `staff`.

**Responses:** 200; 401 `not_authenticated` / `token_not_valid` — missing, expired or revoked access token (`session_revoked` once the session ended).

request.description:
The caller's own unrevoked, unexpired sessions, newest first, paginated (StandardPagination; no filters). `current` marks the session making the request. The test script captures `results.1.uid` (the second-newest session) into `{{auth_sessions_uid}}` — index 0 is normally the current session, and revoking that one would sign this collection out. With a single session nothing is captured and the revoke request answers 404.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · scope: Own sessions only. — Any authenticated staff user. Throttle scope `staff`.

**Responses:** 200; 401 `not_authenticated` / `token_not_valid` — missing, expired or revoked access token (`session_revoked` once the session ended).

request.description:
Revokes one of the caller's own live sessions (other users' sessions are 404 `session_not_found`). Its refresh token is blacklisted and its access tokens stop working on the next request. Revoking the *current* session signs this client out.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · scope: Own sessions only. — Any authenticated staff user. Throttle scope `staff`.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{auth_sessions_uid}}` — Session uid from GET auth/sessions/ (captured from results.1.uid).

**Side effects:** Session revoked_at set, refresh jti blacklisted, session cache namespace bumped; Audit `accounts.session_revoked`

**Responses:** 204 Session signed out.; 401 `not_authenticated` / `token_not_valid` — missing, expired or revoked access token (`session_revoked` once the session ended).; 404 `session_not_found` — not one of your live sessions.

request.description:
Always 200 with the same message, whether or not the address has an account (no account enumeration; the lookup runs in the Celery task `accounts.tasks.send_password_reset`). For an active account a single-use reset link (valid `ACCOUNTS_PASSWORD_RESET_TTL`, 1 h) is e-mailed as `<ACCOUNTS_PASSWORD_RESET_URL>#token=<token>`; at most `ACCOUNTS_RESET_REQUESTS_PER_HOUR` links per account per hour. The token arrives only by e-mail and is not captured.

**Auth:** `none` — Anonymous: ignores any Authorization header. Throttle scope `login` (10/15min per client IP).

**Body fields:** `email`* string:email  (* required)

**Side effects:** Celery task accounts.tasks.send_password_reset enqueued on commit (synchronous fallback if the broker is down); For an active account: earlier open links voided, new PasswordReset row, audit `accounts.password_reset_requested`, reset e-mail queued

**Responses:** 200; 400 `validation_error` — field errors in `errors`.; 429 `throttled`.

request.description:
Completes a password reset or an invitation (new users and force-reset get the same kind of link). `token` is the value after `#token=` in the e-mailed link — set `{{password_reset_token}}` by hand (it only arrives by e-mail). Single use; signs out every session of the account. 400 codes: `reset_token_invalid` (unknown, used, or inactive account), `reset_token_expired`, `validation_error` (password policy).

**Auth:** `none` — Anonymous: ignores any Authorization header. Throttle scope `login` (10/15min per client IP).

**Body fields:** `token`* string; `new_password`* string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Password set, must_reset_password cleared, reset row used + other open links voided; All sessions of the account revoked; Audit `accounts.password_reset`; E-mail queued: password-changed notice

**Responses:** 204 Password set; every session of the account was signed out.; 400 `reset_token_invalid` · `reset_token_expired` · `validation_error`.; 429 `throttled`.

request.description:
Changes the caller's own password; keeps the current session and signs out every other one (returns how many). The new password must pass `AUTH_PASSWORD_VALIDATORS` (min 10 chars, not common, not similar to the user) and differ from the current one. 400 `invalid_current_password` counts towards the sign-in lockout (429 `login_locked`). **Running this really changes the password**: set `{{staff_new_password}}` first and update `{{staff_password}}` afterwards (empty variable → 400).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` — Any authenticated staff user. Throttle scope `staff`; wrong current password counts towards the DB lockout.

**Body fields:** `current_password`* string; `new_password`* string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Other sessions revoked (refresh tokens blacklisted); Audit `accounts.password_changed` (+ `accounts.sessions_revoked`); E-mail queued: password-changed notice

**Responses:** 200; 400 `invalid_current_password` or `validation_error` (password policy / same as current).; 401 `not_authenticated` / `token_not_valid` — missing, expired or revoked access token (`session_revoked` once the session ended).; 429 `login_locked` (Retry-After).

request.description:
Creates a custom role. `permissions` and `scopes` are validated strictly against the permission registry (`GET roles/registry/`): unknown modules, actions or scopes → 400 `validation_error` listing each entry; a permitted module without a scope gets its narrowest default. 409 `slug_taken` / `slug_reserved` (system role slug). Only a Super Admin may grant Super Admin powers (403 `super_admin_required`).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `roles.create`

**Body fields:** `slug`* string:slug; `name`* string; `description` string; `permissions` object {module: [actions]}; `scopes` object {module: scope}  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `accounts.role_created`

**Responses:** 201; 400 `validation_error` — field errors in `errors`.; 401 `not_authenticated` / `token_not_valid` — missing, expired or revoked access token (`session_revoked` once the session ended).; 403 `permission_denied` — the caller's role lacks the required registry permission.; 409 `slug_taken` · `slug_reserved`.

Send the spec that matches the category's `spec_kind`; this example is a 540 Wp mono PERC DCR panel (`panel_spec`, `wattage_w` required when the spec is first created). Alternatives: an inverter category takes `inverter_spec` (`kw` + `inverter_type` ONGRID|HYBRID required; e.g. `{"kw": "5.000", "inverter_type": "ONGRID", "phase": "1P", "topology": "STRING", "mppt_count": 2, "compatible_battery_families": ["dyness-48v-lv"]}`), a battery category `battery_spec` (e.g. `{"family": "{{catalog_battery_families_uid}}", "chemistry": "LFP", "nominal_voltage_v": "48.00", "capacity_kwh": "5.12"}`), a structure category `structure_spec` (e.g. `{"structure_type": "ELEVATED", "material": "GI", "tube_size": "60x40"}`); any other spec key → 400. The SKU is generated as `<sku_prefix>-0001` when omitted (409 `sku_taken`); `attributes` must satisfy the category's JSON Schema (400); `brand_label` defaults to the brand's name; `datasheet` must be a public DOCUMENT and `primary_image` a public IMAGE media uid; the category must be active (400). `tiers` ⊆ BASE, VALUE, PREMIUM.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `catalog.create` · scope: Record scope `all` only (no narrower scope is registered for this module). — Throttle scope `staff` (1200/min). JWT RS256 bearer token.

**Body fields:** `category`* string:uuid; `brand` string:uuid; `brand_label` string; `sku` string; `name`* string; `model` string; `description` string; `attributes` object; `gst_rate_override` string:decimal; `hsn_code_override` string; `unit_override` string [NOS, M, KG, SET]; `is_public` boolean; `is_premium` boolean; `warranty_product_years` integer; `warranty_performance_years` integer; `warranty_extendable_years` integer; `warranty_text` string; `engineering_status` string; `notes` string; `datasheet` string:uuid; `datasheet_url` string:uri; `primary_image` string:uuid; `tiers` array; `panel_spec` object; `inverter_spec` object; `battery_spec` object; `structure_spec` object  (* required)

**Side effects:** Outbox `catalog.component_created` (component_uid, sku, category).; Component change-log row (`created`) and audit row `catalog.component_created`.; Cache namespace `catalog` bumped.

**Responses:** 201 Created (DRAFT).; 400 Validation error envelope `{code, message, errors, error_codes}`.; 401 Missing/invalid access token.; 403 The role lacks the required permission.; 409 Conflict (see description), incl. `stale_version` when `expected_version` is outdated.

_Source: `catalog.views.components.ComponentViewSet` (/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/rest_framework/mixins.py:16) · id `POST /api/v1/catalog/components/`_

request.description:
Two-step CSV import (multipart, UTF-8, ≤ 2 MB, ≤ 5,000 rows, columns as the export; `sku`, `category`, `name` required). 1) `dry_run=true` (default) validates and simulates every row in a rolled-back transaction and returns a per-row report plus an `import_token` when clean (bound to the file's SHA-256 and the user, valid 1 hour). 2) Re-send the **same file** with `dry_run=false` and that `import_token` to commit (all rows or none). 400 `dry_run_required` without a matching token, 400 `import_has_errors` if a row fails at commit, 400 `invalid_csv`, 413 `file_too_large`. Rows with an existing SKU update it (needs `catalog.edit` as well); others create DRAFT components; unknown brand names are created. `status` is informational only.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `catalog.create` · scope: Record scope `all` only (no narrower scope is registered for this module). — Throttle scope `staff` (1200/min). JWT RS256 bearer token. Rows that update existing SKUs also need `catalog.edit`.

**Body fields:** `file`* string:binary; `dry_run` boolean; `import_token` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Commit only: the per-component outbox events, change-log and audit rows of create/update (`catalog.component_created|updated`), audit row `catalog.components_imported`, cache namespace `catalog` bumped. Dry run writes nothing.

**Responses:** 200 Import report.; 400 Validation error envelope `{code, message, errors, error_codes}`.; 401 Missing/invalid access token.; 403 The role lacks the required permission.; 413 File larger than 2 MB (`file_too_large`).

request.description:
One transaction: per line appends a PURCHASE and a LANDED `pricing_price` row (`version_key` `<number>::<sku>`, closing the previous open rows), stores the allocation on the line and makes the batch COMMITTED (immutable). Needs a `reason` (400 `reason_required`) and an `invoice_no` on the batch (409 `invoice_reference_missing`); `effective_from` defaults to today and cannot be in the future (400 `effective_from_in_future`); 409 `batch_not_committable` lists the preview blockers; 409 `batch_not_draft`, `stale_version`.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `procurement.commit` · scope: Record scope `all` only (no narrower scope is registered for this module). — Throttle scope `staff` (1200/min). JWT RS256 bearer token.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{procurement_batches_uid}}` — Uid of the row (captured by the create request).

**Body fields:** `expected_version` integer; `reason`* string; `effective_from` string:date  (* required)

**Side effects:** Outbox `procurement.batch_committed` (batch, supplier, effective_from, committed_at/by, lines with component uid + qty) — inventory books IN/PURCHASE movements into `INVENTORY_RECEIVING_LOCATION` when `INVENTORY_STOCK` is on and that setting is set.; PURCHASE + LANDED price rows appended per line (previous open rows closed).; Audit row `procurement.batch_committed`.; Cache namespace `pricing:authoring` bumped.

**Responses:** 200 The committed batch (detail shape).; 400 Validation error envelope `{code, message, errors, error_codes}`.; 401 Missing/invalid access token.; 403 The role lacks the required permission.; 404 Unknown uid (or soft-deleted).; 409 Conflict (see description), incl. `stale_version` when `expected_version` is outdated.

request.description:
Creates the reversing batch (COMMITTED at once, `reverses` → the original, lines/charges mirrored with negative quantities/amounts). Where the original's PURCHASE/LANDED row is still the current price it is replaced by the row it had superseded (`restored`) or closed when there was none (`closed`); prices a later batch already replaced are left alone (`superseded_since`). Needs a `reason`; `effective_from` defaults to today, not in the future and not before the original's (400). 409 `batch_not_committed`, `batch_is_reversal`, `batch_already_reversed`, `stale_version`. The response is `{reversal, lines}` — the reversal's uid is `reversal.uid` (not captured, so `{{procurement_batches_uid}}` keeps pointing at the original).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `procurement.commit` · scope: Record scope `all` only (no narrower scope is registered for this module). — Throttle scope `staff` (1200/min). JWT RS256 bearer token.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{procurement_batches_uid}}` — Uid of the row (captured by the create request).

**Body fields:** `expected_version` integer; `reason`* string; `effective_from` string:date  (* required)

**Side effects:** Outbox `procurement.batch_reversed` (batch, reversal).; Price rows restored/closed per line.; Audit row `procurement.batch_reversed`.; Cache namespace `pricing:authoring` bumped.

**Responses:** 201 Reversal created.; 400 Validation error envelope `{code, message, errors, error_codes}`.; 401 Missing/invalid access token.; 403 The role lacks the required permission.; 404 Unknown uid (or soft-deleted).; 409 Conflict (see description), incl. `stale_version` when `expected_version` is outdated.

The reason fixes the direction: PURCHASE is IN, ISSUE_TO_PROJECT is OUT (needs `ref_type` + `ref_uid`, e.g. `projects.project` + `{{projects_uid}}`), RETURN and ADJUST either way; ADJUST needs a `note`. `ref_type`/`ref_uid` come together; `procurement.batch_line` is reserved for committed batches. `at` defaults to now and may not be in the future (5 min tolerance, ISO 8601 with offset). An OUT that would take the balance below zero → 409 `insufficient_stock`, unless it is an ADJUST (booked and audited as a negative-stock override, `negative_override: true`). request.description:
Validates every entry against the key registry, then for each **changed** key closes the open row (`effective_to` = new `effective_from`) and appends a new row in one transaction; unchanged values write nothing. `effective_from` defaults to today and may not be in the future (400 `effective_from_in_future`) or before a key's current row (400 `effective_from_before_current`). Unknown key → 400 (serializer choice error); duplicate key → 400. Optional per-entry `current_uid` is an optimistic lock: 409 `stale_version` if the key's current row is no longer that uid (sending `null` asserts the key has no row yet). Writing a margin key (`target_gross_margin_by_tier` or `cost_engine.config`) also needs `pricing_internal.view` (403 `pricing_internal_required`).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `pricing.edit` — Throttle scope `staff`. Margin keys additionally need `pricing_internal.view`.

**Body fields:** `entries`* array; `entries[].key`* choice; `entries[].value`* json; `entries[].current_uid` uuid|null; `effective_from` date; `note` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `pricing.cost_config_set` per written key; Cache bump `pricing:authoring` (when anything was written)

**Responses:** 200 `written` = rows appended (empty when nothing changed); `current` = every current row after the write.; 400 Body fails validation (`validation_error`, field errors in `errors`).; 401 No or invalid bearer JWT (`not_authenticated` / `token_not_valid`).; 403 Caller lacks `pricing.edit` (`permission_denied`). request.description:
Bulk replace (DRAFT sets only, else 409 `market_rate_set_not_draft`): rows are upserted by natural key (system_type, tier, battery_config, size_key, from_size_key, future_size_key, variant); live rows left out are soft-deleted. Rules: `size_key` like `3`, `5sp` (1P), `5tp` (3P); ONGRID/HYBRID need `tier`; HYBRID needs `battery_config` 0/1/2, ONGRID none; UPGRADE needs `from_size_key` and no battery/future/variant; `variant` alphanumeric. Row errors → 400 with `rates[i].field` keys; a duplicate row → 400. Any change bumps the set `version` (409 `stale_version` on a stale `expected_version`). Returns the refreshed set + outcome counts.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `market_rates.edit` · scope: ALL only (module has no narrower record scope; a role without the module sees nothing → 404). — Throttle scope `staff` (1200/min).

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{pricing_market_rate_sets_uid}}` — uid of the market rate set.

**Body fields:** `expected_version` integer ≥ 1; `rates`* array; `rates[].system_type`* choice [ONGRID, HYBRID, UPGRADE]; `rates[].tier` choice [, BASE, VALUE, PREMIUM]; `rates[].battery_config` choice [, 0, 1, 2]; `rates[].size_key`* string ≤ 8; `rates[].from_size_key` string ≤ 8; `rates[].future_size_key` string ≤ 8; `rates[].variant` string ≤ 24; `rates[].customer_price_incl_gst`* decimal(14,2) ≥ 0; `rates[].sort_order` integer ≥ 0  (* required)

**Side effects:** Set `version` bumped when anything changed; Audit `pricing.market_rates_replaced` (with outcome); Cache bump `pricing:authoring`

**Responses:** 200; 400 Body fails validation (`validation_error`, field errors in `errors`).; 401 No or invalid bearer JWT (`not_authenticated` / `token_not_valid`).; 403 Caller lacks `market_rates.edit` (`permission_denied`).; 404 No live market rate set with this identifier (`not_found`).; 409 `market_rate_set_not_draft` or `stale_version`.

The next PriceRelease is built from the ACTIVE set. 409 `market_rate_set_already_active`, 409 `market_rate_set_empty` (no rates), 409 `market_rate_set_activation_conflict`, 409 `stale_version`. Child PUTs bump the set's `version`, so send the current `version` as `expected_version` if you use it (omitted in the example).

request.description:
Adds a manual LIST or LANDED row for a component and closes its current row of the same kind (`effective_to` = new `effective_from`) in one transaction. PURCHASE prices come from procurement batches only. LANDED also needs `pricing_internal.view` (403 `pricing_internal_required`). `effective_from` defaults to today; future → 400 `effective_from_in_future`; before the current row → 400 `effective_from_before_current`. Retired component → 409 `component_retired`. Optional `expected_current_uid` (the current row the client saw; `null` = none) → 409 `stale_version` when it changed.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `pricing.edit` · scope: ALL only (module has no narrower record scope; a role without the module sees nothing → 404). — Throttle scope `staff`. kind=LANDED also needs `pricing_internal.view`.

**Body fields:** `component_uid`* uuid (catalog component); `kind`* choice [LIST, LANDED]; `amount`* decimal(14,2) ≥ 0; `effective_from` date; `gst_inclusive` boolean (default false); `per_watt` decimal(10,4) ≥ 0 | null; `supplier_uid` uuid|null (procurement supplier); `note` string ≤ 2000; `expected_current_uid` uuid|null  (* required)

**Side effects:** Previous current row closed; Audit `pricing.price_set`; Cache bump `pricing:authoring`

**Responses:** 201; 400 `validation_error`, `price_kind_not_manual`, `effective_from_in_future` or `effective_from_before_current`.; 401 No or invalid bearer JWT (`not_authenticated` / `token_not_valid`).; 403 Caller lacks `pricing.edit` (`permission_denied`). Also 403 `pricing_internal_required` for LANDED without `pricing_internal.view`.; 409 `component_retired`, `stale_version` or `price_conflict`.

request.description:
A dry BOM through `engines.bom_builder.build_bom` for system type / size / tier / phase / battery band from the active template of the system type, its slots and matching fixed items, the categories' live non-retired components and current LIST prices, and the package profiles; with `structure` the structure template's lines and tube weight over the system kW. Nothing is written. Required slots left unfilled are returned as `slot_unfilled` warnings. Errors: no active template → 400 `bom_template_missing`; unknown `structure` slug → 400 `validation_error`; engine refusals → 400 with the engine's code (lower-cased).

request.description:
Open a new DRAFT, by default a copy of the current approved version (config **and pins**), or of `based_on_uid`. Only one open draft (DRAFT/SUBMITTED) may exist → 409 `draft_exists`. When no approved version exists yet, send a whole `config` (all ten sections, validated by `engines.pack_config`; see the *first draft* variant) — otherwise 400 `validation_error`. An invalid config → 400 `invalid_config`; copying an imported version without config → 409 `based_on_has_no_config`. The typed packs mirror is rebuilt. `costs` and `pricing` read back as null without `pricing_internal.view`.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `packs.edit` · scope: all (bom/packs have only the `all` record scope) — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Body fields:** `based_on_uid` uuid; `config` object; `note` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit + outbox `packs.config_draft_created` (version_uid, number, status, based_on_number).; Cache namespace `packs:authoring` bumped.; Typed pack mirror (packs_config_pack/line) rebuilt; pins copied from the source version.

**Responses:** 201 The new DRAFT (detail shape, with `config` and `change_log`).; 400 `validation_error` (no approved version and no config; unknown based_on_uid) or `invalid_config`.; 401 No or invalid access token (`not_authenticated`).; 403 The role lacks `packs.edit` (`permission_denied`).; 409 `draft_exists`: an open draft already exists; `based_on_has_no_config`

Audit row, outbox event and `packs:authoring` cache bump on every write.

request.description:
A quotation for a customer you can see (400 `customer_uid` otherwise) with its first DRAFT version pinned to the current PackRelease/PriceRelease/ContentRelease. Inputs are validated against the release: `size_key` must be a size of the system type's template and a released pack must exist for system/size/tier/phase/battery (409 `no_approved_package`); HYBRID needs `battery_config` 0/1/2, ONGRID none; `vehicle_type` must be a configured vehicle (see system-options); `ghs` subsidy needs `ghs_houses`; `source` DISTRICT needs `district`, `affiliate_ref` only with AFFILIATE; `selections.validity_override_days` needs `quotations.approve`. 409 `no_pack_release` when nothing is published. The quotation has no number until issued.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `quotations.create` · scope: `quotations` record scope: `all`, or `owned` (quotations whose `owner` is you). — Throttle scope `staff`.

request.description:

Assigns the number (`GR-<n>`), writes BOM/commercial snapshots and an engineering run, freezes the document + SHA-256, sets `valid_until` from the validity policy (409 `policy_not_configured`) and queues **asynchronous** en + ml PDF renders (`document_status` QUEUED → DONE).

**Side effects:** Outbox `quotations.issued` `{quotation_uid, customer_uid, version_uid, number, version, final_price, language}`.; Two `documents` render jobs (en, ml) queued; Celery `documents.tasks.render_job` enqueued on commit (async PDF).; Engineering run recorded; BOM + commercial snapshots written.; Sequence `QUO` advanced (first issue).; Audit `quotations.issued`; cache namespace `quotations` bumped.

**Responses:** 200 The issued version.; 400 Validation error envelope `{code: validation_error, message, errors, error_codes}`.; 401 Missing/invalid access token (`not_authenticated`).; 403 Lacks `quotations.issue` (`permission_denied`).; 404 Quotation not visible, or `version_not_found` (`not_found`).; 409 `version_not_draft`, `quotation_closed`, `release_required`, `release_superseded`, `discount_pending`, `reduction_exceeds_price`, `number_taken`, `policy_not_configured`, `stale_version`.; 422 `generation_blocked` — a gate check failed.

Edit a DRAFT (409 `agreement_not_draft`). A quotation-derived draft accepts only free fields (language, extras, consumer number, registered phone, wheeling …); technical, equipment, price fields and lines are 400 `field_pinned`. Prices are recomputed. Issuing a SALE_ORDER needs `panel_uid` (MAIN_PANEL) and `inverter_uid` (MAIN_INVERTER) set — `{{catalog_components_uid}}` must be a panel here; add an inverter component uid before issuing. Send `expected_version` (409 `stale_version`).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `agreements.edit` · scope: `agreements` record scope: `all`, or `owned` (agreements whose `owner` is you). — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{agreements_uid}}` — Agreement uid.

**Body fields:** `expected_version` integer; `language` string [en, ml, hi]; `system_type` string [ON_GRID, HYBRID]; `capacity_kw` string:decimal; `size_label` string; `phase` string [1P, 3P]; `variant` string [BASE, VALUE, PREMIUM]; `panel_uid` string:uuid; `panel_qty` integer; `panel_capacity_label` string; `inverter_uid` string:uuid; `inverter_qty` integer; `battery_uid` string:uuid; `battery_qty` integer; `structure_template_uid` string:uuid; `structure_type` string; `structure_material` string; `extra_structure` boolean; `walkway_required` boolean; `ladder_required` boolean; `original_price` string:decimal; `extra_cost` string:decimal; `add_on_offer` string; `extra_description` string; `consumer_number` string; `registered_phone` string; `wheeling_required` boolean; `lines` array  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `agreements.draft_updated`; cache namespace `agreements` bumped.

**Responses:** 200 The updated draft.; 400 Validation error (unknown component/role, bad phone, …) or `field_pinned`.; 401 Missing/invalid access token (`not_authenticated`).; 403 Lacks `agreements.edit` (`permission_denied`).; 404 Row not found or outside your record scope (`not_found`).; 409 `agreement_not_draft`, `stale_version`.

request.description:

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `agreements.issue` · scope: `agreements` record scope: `all`, or `owned` (agreements whose `owner` is you). — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Responses:** 200 The issued agreement.; 400 Validation error envelope `{code: validation_error, message, errors, error_codes}`.; 401 Missing/invalid access token (`not_authenticated`).; 403 Lacks `agreements.issue` (`permission_denied`).; 404 Row not found or outside your record scope (`not_found`).; 409 `agreement_not_draft`, `quotation_version_superseded`, `quotation_closed`, `supersedes_not_in_force`, `agreement_exists`, `stale_version`.; 422 `agreement_incomplete`.

Optional `quotation_version_uid` re-pins a PA/SO to another ISSUED version of the same customer's quotations. 409 `agreement_not_in_force`, `already_superseded`, `stale_version`. The new draft's uid replaces `{{agreements_uid}}`.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `agreements.issue` · scope: `agreements` record scope: `all`, or `owned` (agreements whose `owner` is you). — Throttle scope `staff`.

request.description:
Creates a PRE_SALE inspection in DRAFT (agreement inspections are created automatically from the `agreements.issued` event). Number `SV-YYYYMMDD-NNNN` is reserved; `visit_date` defaults to today; address/pincode/location/district default from the customer; `system_type` defaults to UNDECIDED. `customer_uid` must be a customer visible to you (404 `customer_not_found`). Setting `engineer_uid` needs `site_inspections.assign` (403 `assign_forbidden`) and the user must hold `site_inspections.edit` (400 `not_a_field_engineer`).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `site_inspections.create` · scope: Record scope of `site_inspections` (all / owned = customers I own or inspections I created / assigned = inspections assigned to me); child records are reached only through a visible inspection. — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Body fields:** `customer_uid`* string:uuid; `engineer_uid` string:uuid; `visit_date` string:date; `system_type` string [ON_GRID, HYBRID, UNDECIDED]; `address` string; `pincode` string; `location` string; `district` string; `quotation_version_uid` string:uuid  (* required)

**Side effects:** Snapshot #1 (source PRE_SALE) written.; Audit `site_inspections.created`.; Cache namespace `site_inspections` bumped.

**Responses:** 201; 400 Validation (`pincode` 6 digits, unknown/inactive `engineer_uid`) or `not_a_field_engineer`.; 401 Missing/invalid staff JWT.; 403 No `site_inspections.create`, or `assign_forbidden` when setting `engineer_uid` without `assign`.; 404 `customer_not_found` (not visible to you).

After COMPLETED a `reason` is required (400 `reason_required`) and the inspection is sent back to REVISION_REQUIRED (standing approvals superseded). 409 `invalid_status` while ON_HOLD.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `site_inspections.approve` · scope: Record scope of `site_inspections` (all / owned = customers I own or inspections I created / assigned = inspections assigned to me); child records are reached only through a visible inspection. — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{site_inspections_uid}}` — Site inspection uid.

**Side effects:** Audit `site_inspections.system_type_changed`; after completion also `revision_required` + `status_changed`.; Obsolete equipment checklists soft-deleted.; Cache namespace `site_inspections` bumped.

**Responses:** 200; 400 Validation or `reason_required`.; 401 Missing/invalid staff JWT.; 403 Missing the registry permission (`permission_denied`).; 404 Inspection not found or outside your record scope (`not_found`).; 409 `invalid_status` (on hold), `inspection_read_only` (released) or `stale_version`.

request.description:
From COMPLETED (or CUSTOMER_APPROVAL_PENDING to issue a fresh link) on a SUITABLE/CONDITIONAL site: creates a PENDING approval with the snapshot of both current rectangles, supersedes an earlier PENDING one, moves the inspection to CUSTOMER_APPROVAL_PENDING and returns the **customer link once** (`link` = `/api/customer/v1/inspection-approvals/<token>/`, 7-day expiry; only its hash is stored). The Postman test captures the token from `link` into `customer_inspection_approvals_token`. Send the link to the customer yourself (SMS/WhatsApp) — this endpoint sends nothing. `customer_phone` defaults to the customer's phone; a number not on the customer record needs `approve` (403 `phone_not_customer`); it must be an Indian mobile (400 `phone_not_indian_mobile`). Route permission is `view`; the service requires `submit` or `approve` (403 `submit_or_approve_required`).

request.description:
Full replace validated against the pinned check definition: `results` maps check id → PASS | FAIL | NEEDS_REVIEW | NOT_APPLICABLE | NOT_CHECKED (missing = NOT_CHECKED; unknown id/value → 400 `invalid_results`); status is recomputed over every check; omitted text fields are cleared. A FAIL needs `evidence_photo_uid` (400 `evidence_required`); FAIL/REQUIRES_REVIEW needs `issue` (400 `issue_required`), sets `review_status` PENDING and opens an EQUIPMENT engineering review. 409 `system_type_undecided`; 400 `equipment_not_required`. `expected_version` is the checklist's `version` (checked only once saved). Engineer write window: only in DRAFT / IN_PROGRESS / REVISION_REQUIRED (409 `inspection_read_only` after approval, `invalid_status` otherwise); the first write on a DRAFT/REVISION_REQUIRED inspection moves it to IN_PROGRESS (409 `engineer_required` without an assigned engineer).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `site_inspections.edit` · scope: Record scope of `site_inspections` (all / owned = customers I own or inspections I created / assigned = inspections assigned to me); child records are reached only through a visible inspection. — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{site_inspections_uid}}` — Site inspection uid.; `equipment_type` (str) ← `{{site_inspections_equipment_equipment_type}}` — Equipment checklist: ON_GRID_INVERTER (ON_GRID systems) or HYBRID_INVERTER / HYBRID_BATTERY (HYBRID systems). choices: ON_GRID_INVERTER, HYBRID_INVERTER, HYBRID_BATTERY

**Body fields:** `results`* object; `issue` string; `corrective_action` string; `engineer_remarks` string; `evidence_photo_uid` string:uuid; `expected_version` integer  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `site_inspections.equipment_saved` (result counts).; May open an EQUIPMENT engineering review.; Cache namespace `site_inspections` bumped.

**Responses:** 200; 400 `invalid_results`, `evidence_required`, `issue_required`, `equipment_not_required`, `photo_not_in_inspection`.; 401 Missing/invalid staff JWT.; 403 Missing the registry permission (`permission_denied`).; 404 Inspection not found or outside your record scope (`not_found`).; 409 `system_type_undecided`, `stale_version`, `inspection_read_only`, `invalid_status`, `engineer_required`.

request.description:
Wizard stage 1 — Site & access. Partial update of **only this stage's columns** (any other key is 400 "Not writable in this stage."); returns the full inspection. Setting `latitude`/`longitude` derives `google_map_link` and stamps `location_captured_at` (unless sent). `pincode` must be 6 digits; latitude −90…90, longitude −180…180. `has_location_restrictions: true` needs `customer_location_remarks` before submit. Engineer write window: only in DRAFT / IN_PROGRESS / REVISION_REQUIRED (409 `inspection_read_only` after approval, `invalid_status` otherwise); the first write on a DRAFT/REVISION_REQUIRED inspection moves it to IN_PROGRESS (409 `engineer_required` without an assigned engineer). `expected_version` is the inspection's `version` (409 `stale_version`).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `site_inspections.edit` · scope: Record scope of `site_inspections` (all / owned = customers I own or inspections I created / assigned = inspections assigned to me); child records are reached only through a visible inspection. — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{site_inspections_uid}}` — Site inspection uid.

**Body fields:** `address` string; `pincode` string; `location` string; `district` string; `latitude` string:decimal; `longitude` string:decimal; `location_accuracy_m` string:decimal; `location_captured_at` string:date-time; `road_access` string [GOOD, LIMITED, DIFFICULT, NO_VEHICLE]; `vehicle_type` string [CAR, PICKUP_VAN, TRUCK, MANUAL, NOT_ASSESSED]; `access_remarks` string; `has_location_restrictions` boolean; `customer_restrictions` string; `customer_location_remarks` string; `expected_version` integer  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `site_inspections.stage_saved` with the changed columns.; First write moves DRAFT/REVISION_REQUIRED → IN_PROGRESS.; May open an engineering review (ROOF / STRUCTURE / GENERATION / MANUAL triggers).; Cache namespace `site_inspections` bumped.

**Responses:** 200; 400 Validation or a key outside this stage (`Not writable in this stage.`).; 401 Missing/invalid staff JWT.; 403 Missing the registry permission (`permission_denied`).; 404 Inspection not found or outside your record scope (`not_found`).; 409 `stale_version`, `inspection_read_only`, `invalid_status`, `engineer_required`.

request.description:
Runs the engineering checker (ACTIVE checker rule set, current PriceRelease) on the BOM lines and stores the verdict as an engineering run **whether or not the lock succeeds**. Refused with 409 `bom_lock_refused` (errors: `engineering_run`, `blocked`, `missing_acknowledgements`) while a BLOCK finding is unwaived (engineering waives under `engineering/findings/<uid>/acknowledge/`) or a WARN finding that needs one has no acknowledgement (`{rule_code, reason}`). On success the snapshot (lines with list price/landed cost, verdict, acknowledgements) is frozen into `bom_lock` and the project moves PLANNED → IN_PROGRESS; it is never unlocked. The first edit creates the row (version 1) and applies the change (version 2). `expected_version` is the **SEO block's** `version` (1 for the unsaved defaults) → 409 `stale_version`. `og_image` must be a live public image asset uid; `schema_extra` an object ≤ 16 KB; unknown fields → 400. Every change also touches the page (page `version` + 1, verification cleared). With `schema_type` = `WebPage` the public payload carries generated WebPage JSON-LD.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `pages.edit` · scope: Module has only the `all` scope (no record-scope filter registered). — Throttle scope `staff` (1200/min).

Sets the `value` of one text slot (the only editable field; trimmed; empty = the website keeps its built-in text). `value` is **required** by the view even though this is a PATCH. Capped at the slot's `max_length` and checked against its `kind` (SHORT_TEXT single line, URL http(s) or `/path`, EMAIL, PHONE): 400 `validation_error`. `expected_version` is the **slot's** `version` → 409 `stale_version`. Unknown key → 404 `slot_not_found`. Seeded keys (career page): `hero_title` (SHORT_TEXT, max 90), `hero_subtitle` (LONG_TEXT, max 220).

Only the career page (`/career`, slug `career`) declares slots in the registry (`sitepages.services.registry.SLOTS`), so this request uses `{{career_page_uid}}`; any other page answers 404 `slot_not_found`.; `key` (str) ← `{{pages_text_slots_key}}` — Text slot key (`^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`). request.description:
Links a posting (its title and department are snapshotted; the submitted position text is kept) and/or sets the assignee (`null` clears). At least one of `position`/`assignee` is required (400). The assignee must be an active user who can view applications (400 `invalid_assignee`); an unknown or deleted posting is 400. Archived applications accept only `restore/` (409 `application_archived`).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `applications.edit` — Bearer JWT (RS256). Throttle scope `staff` (1200/min). Default deny: the role needs the grant below.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{careers_applications_uid}}` — `uid` of the job application.

**Body fields:** `position` uuid; `assignee` uuid; `expected_version` integer  (* required)

**Side effects:** Timeline events `ASSIGNED` (posting linked) and/or `ASSIGNEE`.; Audit row `careers.application_assigned`.

**Responses:** 200; 400 `validation_error` (neither field sent, unknown uid) or `invalid_assignee`.; 401 `not_authenticated` — missing/expired access token.; 403 `permission_denied` — the role lacks the grant.; 404 `not_found` — no live row with this uid.; 409 `application_archived` or `stale_version`.

**Needs review:** Example sets only `assignee` = `{{users_uid}}` (the user created in Accounts); it succeeds only if that user's role grants `applications.view` (else 400 `invalid_assignee`). Linking `position` = `{{careers_positions_uid}}` is not used in the run because it would make the cleanup DELETE of the posting fail with 409 `position_has_applications`.

request.description:
Link an existing login (`user_uid`) **or** create a Staff login and e-mail an invitation (`email`) — exactly one (400 otherwise). The Staff role replaces the login's role only when that role grants nothing beyond Staff; a deactivated Staff login is reactivated. 409 `employee_inactive`, `employee_already_linked`, `user_already_linked`, `user_inactive`; 404 `user_not_found`; 403 when the login holds grants you do not (or `own_role_change`).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `employees.edit` · scope: Record scope `employees`: all / office (employees of the caller's own office) / self (the caller's own employee record); fail closed without a linked employee. — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{hr_employees_uid}}` — Employee uid.

**Body fields:** `expected_version` integer; `user_uid` string:uuid; `email` string:email; `first_name` string; `last_name` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `hr.employee_user_linked` (+ `hr.staff_role_assigned` when the role changes).; With `email`: a new Staff user is created and an invitation e-mail (password-set link) is sent.; Cache namespace `hr:employees` bumped.

**Responses:** 200 The employee and what happened to the account.; 400 `validation_error` envelope `{code, message, errors, error_codes}` (field errors in `errors`).; 401 Not authenticated (missing/expired staff JWT).; 403 `permission_denied` / `own_role_change`.; 404 `not_found` / `user_not_found`.; 409 `employee_inactive`, `employee_already_linked`, `user_already_linked`, `user_inactive`, e-mail already used, `stale_version`.

request.description:
Compares the employee list with every registered terminal's users. Preview by default (`apply=false`); `apply` needs `confirm=true` (400 `confirmation_required`) and then links matching PINs, creates employees for new PINs (needs `employees.create`) and deactivates employees absent from every terminal. `read_devices` first asks the office agents to re-read the user tables. Requires the `employees` scope `all` (403 otherwise); 503 `devices_unavailable` without the devices package.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `employees.edit` · scope: Needs employees scope `all` (403 otherwise). — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Body fields:** `read_devices` boolean; `apply` boolean; `confirm` boolean  (* required)

**Side effects:** `read_devices=true`: a user-table read is requested from the agent of every active agent-delivered device.; `apply=true`: device links created, employees created/deactivated (each with its own audit rows and outbox events, e.g. `hr.employee_deactivated`).

**Responses:** 200 The reconciliation report.; 400 `confirmation_required` (apply without confirm) / `validation_error`.; 401 Not authenticated (missing/expired staff JWT).; 403 `permission_denied`: no `employees.edit`, or employees scope is not `all`.; 503 `devices_unavailable`: the devices package provides no reconciler.

request.description:
Archive the employee (optionally recording `left_on`, not before `joined_on`). The linked login is deactivated and signed out by the accounts handler of `hr.employee_deactivated`. Repeating it on an inactive employee whose login is still active retires that login; otherwise a no-op. 403 `self_action_denied` on your own record; 403 when the linked login holds grants you could not manage.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `employees.archive` · scope: Record scope `employees`: all / office (employees of the caller's own office) / self (the caller's own employee record); fail closed without a linked employee. — deny_self_action guard. Throttle scope `staff`.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{hr_employees_uid}}` — Employee uid.

**Body fields:** `expected_version` integer; `note` string; `left_on` string:date  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `hr.employee_deactivated`.; Outbox `hr.employee_deactivated` {employee_uid, user_uid} → accounts deactivates the login and ends its sessions.; Outbox `hr.attendance_inputs_changed` (reason employee_deactivated).; Cache namespace `hr:employees` bumped.

**Responses:** 200 The employee.; 400 `validation_error` envelope `{code, message, errors, error_codes}` (field errors in `errors`).; 401 Not authenticated (missing/expired staff JWT).; 403 `self_action_denied` / `permission_denied`.; 404 `not_found`.; 409 `stale_version`: `expected_version` is not the row's current version.

request.description:
Self-service when `employee` is omitted (your linked employee; 403 `employee_not_linked` without one) — PENDING unless the type needs no approval. An approver (`leave.approve`) filing for someone else gets it APPROVED at once (never for themselves). The employee must be in your `leave` scope (400 `employee_not_found`) and active (409 `employee_inactive`). Dates ordered, a half day is one date, at most 366 days (400); 409 `leave_overlap` with another pending/approved request.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `leave.create` · scope: Record scope `leave`: all / office (leave of the caller's office) / self (own leave); fail closed without a linked employee. — deny_self_action: an approver's own leave stays PENDING. Throttle scope `staff`.

**Body fields:** `employee` string:uuid; `leave_type`* string:uuid; `date_from`* string:date; `date_to`* string:date; `is_half_day` boolean; `reason` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `hr.leave_created`.; When created APPROVED: outbox `hr.attendance_inputs_changed` (reason leave_approved).; Cache namespace `hr:leave` bumped.

**Responses:** 201 The leave record (PENDING or APPROVED).; 400 `validation_error` / `employee_not_found`.; 401 Not authenticated (missing/expired staff JWT).; 403 `permission_denied` / `employee_not_linked`.; 409 `leave_overlap`, `employee_inactive`.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `leave.view` · scope: Record scope `leave`: all / office (leave of the caller's office) / self (own leave); fail closed without a linked employee. — View gate is `leave.view`; the service then requires `leave.create` (own) or `leave.approve` (others). Throttle scope `staff`.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{hr_leave_uid}}` — Leave record uid.

**Body fields:** `expected_version` integer; `note` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `hr.leave_cancelled`.; Outbox `hr.attendance_inputs_changed` when it was APPROVED (reason leave_cancelled).; Cache namespace `hr:leave` bumped.

**Responses:** 200 The cancelled record.; 400 `validation_error` envelope `{code, message, errors, error_codes}` (field errors in `errors`).; 401 Not authenticated (missing/expired staff JWT).; 403 `permission_denied`.; 404 `not_found`.; 409 `leave_not_cancellable`, `leave_already_started`, `stale_version`.

request.description:
Corrects one field of a stored day (`day_uid` within your scope, else 404); the day is pinned (`is_corrected`) and the recompute leaves it alone until revoked. `new` is validated by the engine: a status (PRESENT…), whole minutes (≤ 2880), true/false, or an office wall-clock `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]` (or null) for first_in/last_out (OUT not before IN). 403 `self_action_denied` on your own day; 409 `correction_exists` (revoke the active one first), `stale_version` (`expected_version` is the **day's** version).

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `attendance.edit` · scope: Record scope `attendance`: all / office (caller's office) / self (own linked employee); fail closed without a linked employee. — deny_self_action guard (attendance.edit). Throttle scope `staff`.

**Body fields:** `day_uid`* string:uuid; `field`* string [status, first_in, last_out, working_minutes, break_minutes, late_minutes, early_exit_minutes, overtime_minutes, is_late, is_early_exit]; `new`* any; `reason`* string; `expected_version` integer  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `attendance.day_corrected` (on the day).; Day row updated and pinned (`is_corrected`).; Attendance days cache namespace bumped.

**Responses:** 201 The correction.; 400 `validation_error` envelope `{code, message, errors, error_codes}` (field errors in `errors`).; 401 Not authenticated (missing/expired staff JWT).; 403 `permission_denied` / `self_action_denied`.; 404 `not_found`: day unknown or outside your scope.; 409 `correction_exists`, `stale_version`.

request.description:
Creates the agent and its platform service credential (kind AGENT). The plaintext token `fl_<prefix>_<secret>` is returned **once** (only its hash is kept), with a one-time `config_download` key for `GET …/config-download/` (valid 10 min). Intervals: heartbeat 10–3600 s, sync 30–86400 s, offline_after ≥ heartbeat. Requires `devices.manage` (not `create`). 409 `agent_code_taken`.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `devices.manage` — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Body fields:** `code`* string; `name`* string; `office` string:uuid; `heartbeat_interval_seconds` integer; `sync_interval_seconds` integer; `offline_after_seconds` integer; `degraded_queue_threshold` integer; `settings` object; `notes` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Service credential issued (audited by core).; Audit `devices.agent_created`.; Token parked Fernet-encrypted in the cache for one config download (TTL `DEVICES_AGENT_CONFIG_TTL_SECONDS`, 600 s).; Cache bump `devices:devices`, `devices:agents`.

**Responses:** 201 Agent + token (shown once) + one-time config download key.; 400 `validation_error` (intervals out of range, offline_after < heartbeat, settings not an object).; 401 Missing, malformed or expired staff JWT.; 403 The role lacks `devices.manage` (default deny).; 409 `agent_code_taken`.

request.description:
Acts on one reconciliation row; `confirm: true` is mandatory (400 `confirmation_required`). `LINK_EXISTING` needs `employee_uid` (409 `device_user_already_linked` if linked to someone else). `CREATE_EMPLOYEE` creates the employee (code defaults to the PIN, name to the terminal's name, office to the device's) and needs `employees.create` as well (403 `permission_denied`). 409 `stale_version`.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `devices.edit` — Throttle scope `staff`. CREATE_EMPLOYEE additionally requires employees.create.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{devices_device_users_uid}}` — Device-user uid (one terminal user = one (device, PIN) row).

**Body fields:** `action`* string [LINK_EXISTING, CREATE_EMPLOYEE]; `confirm` boolean; `employee_uid` string:uuid; `employee_code` string; `full_name` string; `office_uid` string:uuid; `shift_uid` string:uuid; `expected_version` integer  (* required)

**Side effects:** CREATE_EMPLOYEE: employee created through hr services (its own audit/events).; Audit `devices.device_user_linked` (note `resolve: …`).; Outbox `hr.attendance_inputs_changed` (reason `device_link_changed`).; Cache bump `devices:devices`, `devices:device_users`.

**Responses:** 200; 400 `confirmation_required` (confirm not true) or `validation_error` (missing employee_uid for LINK_EXISTING, no name for CREATE_EMPLOYEE).; 401 Missing, malformed or expired staff JWT.; 403 Lacks `devices.edit`, or `employees.create` for CREATE_EMPLOYEE.; 404 No live row with that uid.; 409 `device_user_already_linked` or `stale_version`.

request.description:
Registers a terminal. It must be locatable: an `ip_address`, or the serial on the label (`serial_number` is normalised and also becomes `expected_serial`, the pin an agent/ADMS push must report). `agent` (an active agent) binds it now; later changes of agent go only through `rehome/`. `comm_password` (0–999999) is write-only. 400 `device_not_locatable` without an address or serial; 400 `validation_error` for a bad MAC or a revoked/disabled agent; 409 `device_serial_taken` when another live device reports or is pinned to the serial.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `devices.create` — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Body fields:** `name`* string; `serial_number` string; `expected_serial` string; `expected_mac` string; `office` string:uuid; `agent` string:uuid; `ip_address` string:ip; `port` integer; `protocol` string [ZK_TCP, ZK_UDP]; `comm_password` integer; `timeout_seconds` integer; `adms_server` string; `adms_port` integer; `notes` string; `is_active` boolean  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `devices.device_created`.; Cache bump `devices:devices`.

**Responses:** 201 The device (full DeviceSerializer shape).; 400 `validation_error` (field errors) or `device_not_locatable` (no ip_address and no serial).; 401 Missing, malformed or expired staff JWT.; 403 The role lacks `devices.create` (default deny).; 409 `device_serial_taken`: another live device reports or is pinned to this serial.

Unchanged values are a no-op. 400 `device_not_locatable` if the device would keep neither an address nor a serial; 409 `device_serial_taken`; 409 `stale_version`.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `devices.edit` — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Responses:** 200; 400 `validation_error` / `device_not_locatable`.; 401 Missing, malformed or expired staff JWT.; 403 The role lacks `devices.edit` (default deny).; 404 No live row with that uid.; 409 `device_serial_taken` or `stale_version`.

Agent announce never re-homes a device (it answers 409 `device_bound_elsewhere`). 400 `validation_error` for a revoked/disabled agent or blank reason; 409 `stale_version`.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `devices.manage` — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{devices_uid}}` — Device uid.

**Body fields:** `agent_uid`* string:uuid; `office_uid` string:uuid; `reason`* string; `expected_version` integer  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `devices.device_rehomed` (note = reason) when something changed.; Cache bump `devices:devices`.

**Responses:** 200; 400 `validation_error` (unknown uid, revoked agent, blank reason).; 401 Missing, malformed or expired staff JWT.; 403 The role lacks `devices.manage` (default deny).; 404 No live row with that uid.; 409 `stale_version`: `expected_version` is not the row's current version.

_Source: `devices.views.devices.DeviceViewSet` (devices/views/device_actions.py:66) · id `POST /api/v1/devices/{uid}/rehome/`_

request.description:
Issues a new per-device push token (shown **once**; only its sha256 is stored) and enables push: the terminal's server path becomes `/iclock/<token>/`. Enabling again issues a new token and invalidates the old one. `allowed_ips` = IPs/CIDRs the terminal may push from (omit: unchanged; `[]`: any). 409 `device_serial_required` for a device with neither serial nor expected serial (the receiver admits a push only when serial AND token belong together); 409 `stale_version`. The receiver itself is gated by flag `ADMS_RECEIVER`.

**Auth:** `staff_jwt` · permission `devices.manage` — Throttle scope `staff`.

**Path params:** `uid` (uuid) ← `{{devices_uid}}` — Device uid.

**Body fields:** `allowed_ips` array[string]; `expected_version` integer  (* required)

**Side effects:** Audit `devices.device_adms_enabled` (token_issued: true; the token itself is never logged).; Cache bump `devices:devices`.

**Responses:** 200; 400 `validation_error` (e.g. an entry of allowed_ips is not an IP/CIDR).; 401 Missing, malformed or expired staff JWT.; 403 The role lacks `devices.manage` (default deny).; 404 No live row with that uid.; 409 `device_serial_required` or `stale_version`.; 503 Declared in the schema (ErrorSerializer); no 503 path found in the view/service code.

**Needs review:** 503 is declared in the OpenAPI schema for adms/enable but no code path raises it.

request.description:
Sends a one-time code (Twilio Verify) to an **Indian mobile number** (any common spelling; normalised to E.164) for the lead forms. `name` is accepted for legacy forms and not stored. Backend `LEADS_OTP_BACKEND`: `twilio` in staging/prod; `fake` in dev/test (no SMS, the code is always `000000` — the dev default in `flarize/settings/dev.py` and `.env.docker.example`). Non-Indian/landline numbers → 400 `otp_phone_unsupported`; more than 10 sends per number in 24 h (DB cap, `LEADS_OTP_MAX_SENDS_PER_PHONE_PER_DAY`) or a Twilio 429 → 429 `otp_limit_reached`; provider unconfigured/unreachable → 503 `otp_unavailable`; Twilio rejects the number → 400 `otp_send_failed`. The code expires after 600 s.

**Auth:** `none` — Anonymous. Throttles (replace the default `public_write`): `otp` 5/10min per normalised phone number (falls back to client IP when the body has no valid number) and `otp_ip` 20/10min per client IP; both fail open on a cache outage (the DB cap still holds). Honours `Idempotency-Key`.

**Body fields:** `phone`* string; `name` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** SMS one-time code via Twilio Verify (fake backend in dev/test: recorded in memory/cache, no SMS); Inserts a `leads_otp_request` row (after the provider accepted); Audit row `leads.otp_sent` (actor kind CUSTOMER)

**Responses:** 200 A code was sent (fake backend: use 000000).; 400 `validation_error` (bad phone), `otp_phone_unsupported`, `otp_send_failed`.; 409 `idempotency_in_progress`: a request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed.; 422 `idempotency_key_reused`: the Idempotency-Key was used with a different body.; 429 `throttled` (otp / otp_ip) or `otp_limit_reached`.; 503 `otp_unavailable`: the SMS provider is not configured or unreachable.

request.description:
Every website enquiry form. `kind` and `form` complete each other (either may be omitted; a mismatching pair is 400; `STUDIO` is refused). A phone is required for every kind but `CONTACT` (which may give only an e-mail); **a submission with a phone needs `verification_token` from `otp/verify` for that same number** (400 `verification_required` / `verification_invalid` / `verification_expired` / `verification_mismatch`) — run OTP send → verify first. `website` is a honeypot and must stay empty. `details` = flat object of ≤ 30 scalars; `calculator` ≤ 8 KB; `utm` only utm_source/medium/campaign/term/content, gclid, fbclid, referrer. A phone matching a live customer links the lead to it (and assigns the customer's owner). Every submission creates a new lead (`L-<n>`).

**Auth:** `none` — Anonymous (`AllowAny`, no authentication classes). Throttle `public_write` 20/min per client IP. Honours `Idempotency-Key`.

**Body fields:** `kind` string [HOME_ENQUIRY, ADVANCED_CALC, GROUP_PURCHASE, CONTACT, REFERRAL, QUOTE_REQUEST]; `form` string [FOOTER, HOME_BOOKING, CONTACT_PAGE, GROUP_PURCHASE, QUOTATION, QUOTE_REQUEST, REFERRAL_PARTNER, WARRANTY_SERVICE, OTHER]; `name`* string; `phone` string; `email` string:email; `pincode` string; `district` string; `message` string; `page` string; `details` object; `calculator` object; `utm` object; `verification_token` string; `website` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Outbox `leads.created` (channel `website`); Lead event CREATED; Audit row `leads.lead_created` (actor kind CUSTOMER); Cache bump `leads`

**Responses:** 201; 400 `validation_error` (fields, honeypot `Invalid submission.`, kind/form mismatch, missing phone/e-mail) or `verification_required` / `verification_invalid` / `verification_expired` / `verification_mismatch`.; 409 `idempotency_in_progress`: a request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed.; 422 `idempotency_key_reused`: the Idempotency-Key was used with a different body.; 429 `throttled` (public_write).

Hosts whose stated serial equals the pin of one of this agent's active devices locate that device (ip/port/MAC/firmware updated, identity VERIFIED); a MAC contradicting the known one is recorded as an identity mismatch instead. Decides no identity for unmatched hosts. Writes an INFO sync log (`LAN_DISCOVERY`).

request.description:
Binds or refreshes a terminal by the serial it reports (serial_number, then the expected_serial pin; the LAN address only for this agent's own serial-less record). An unknown serial creates the device under this agent's office (`created: true`). Never re-homes: 409 `device_bound_elsewhere` (another agent's device, or an unbound device of another office — recorded and audited); 409 `device_inactive`; 409 `identity_mismatch` when the serial/MAC contradicts the pin (recorded, sticky). On success identity becomes VERIFIED and last_seen_at moves.

**Auth:** `agent_token` · scope: Only devices bound to the calling agent are visible/writable. — `Authorization: Bearer {{agent_token}}` (`fl_<prefix>_<secret>`, issued by POST devices/agents/ or rotate-token/). Service token must belong to a live, active agent. Throttle scope `agent` (120/min).

request.description:
Sends a one-time code by SMS (leads Twilio Verify client, purpose APPROVAL) to the phone stored on the approval and returns it masked. No request body. Only the latest, PENDING, unexpired approval of an inspection in CUSTOMER_APPROVAL_PENDING can be answered: 409 `approval_closed` otherwise, 410 `link_expired` after expiry. In dev (`LEADS_OTP_BACKEND=fake`) no SMS is sent and the code is always `000000`.

**Auth:** `customer_link` — Customer surface: no session auth (`CustomerAPIView`, AllowAny); the link token in the path is the capability. Throttle scope `customer` (60/min). Responses are `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

**Path params:** `token` (str) ← `{{customer_inspection_approvals_token}}` — Customer approval link token. Issued once by `POST /api/v1/site-inspections/{uid}/approval/request/` (response field `link` = `/api/customer/v1/inspection-approvals/<token>/`; only its SHA-256 is stored, 7-day expiry). Captured into `customer_inspection_approvals_token` by regex on `link`.

The customer's answer: `decision` APPROVED or REJECTED with the one-time `code` from `send-otp/` (4–10 digits; `000000` in dev). A rejection needs a `comment` (400 `comment_required`). request.description:
ZKTeco/eSSL ADMS push receiver (plain Django view, CSRF-exempt, outside DRF). Gated by flag `ADMS_RECEIVER` (404 JSON `not_found` while off). Authentication is the secret token in the path **and** the `SN` the request states: they must belong to the same device, which must be active, `adms_enabled` and (if it has an allow-list) pushing from an allowed IP. Every reply is HTTP 200 `text/plain; charset=utf-8` with explicit Content-Length. Every request is recorded as evidence (`devices_adms_request`, token redacted). No SN → `OK`, evidence only; unknown token or SN not matching the token → `OK`, serial quarantined (UNKNOWN_SERIAL/TOKEN_MISMATCH), nothing ingested; refused device → `OK`, evidence only. Throttled per token (`iclock` 300/min): beyond it the reply is `ERROR` and nothing is recorded. A failure inside the server answers `ERROR` so the terminal resends.

**GET**: `cdata` (any GET, or `options=` present) is the HANDSHAKE → the option block (`GET OPTION FROM: <SN>` … `TransFlag=AttLog OpLog`, no TimeZone so the terminal clock is never set; no photos/templates requested). `getrequest` is the command poll → `OK` (this server never issues commands). `ping`, `registry` → `OK`. An unknown terminal is never given the option block (`OK`).

**Auth:** `device_token` — Token in the path + matching `SN` query param (serial AND token). No header auth; CSRF-exempt. Throttle `iclock` 300/min per token (reply `ERROR`). Flag `ADMS_RECEIVER`.

**Flag:** `ADMS_RECEIVER` must be enabled (404 otherwise).

**Path params:** `device_token` (str) ← `{{iclock_device_token}}` — The per-device push token issued (shown once) by POST /api/v1/devices/{uid}/adms/enable/. Only its sha256 is stored; ≤ 128 chars.; `endpoint` (str) ← `{{iclock_known_endpoint}}` — Firmware endpoint: cdata (handshake on GET / table push on POST), getrequest (command poll), devicecmd (command result), registry, ping. `.aspx` suffix and trailing slash are optional (`cdata.aspx`, `cdata/`). choices: cdata, getrequest, devicecmd, registry, ping

**Side effects:** Evidence row in `devices_adms_request` for every request (body ≤ 1 MiB stored, passwords/templates redacted, ATTPHOTO/BIODATA never stored; purged after 30 days).; Admitted request: device ADMS contact counters/timestamps updated (handshake → REGISTERED; getrequest → last command poll; table push → last push).; HANDSHAKE: device `adms_options` stored; a label-registered device adopts the stated serial (identity VERIFIED).; ATTLOG: punches ingested through the shared ingestion (content dedup with agent uploads), SyncLog ATTENDANCE, outbox `attendance.punches_ingested` when new.; USERINFO / OPERLOG `USER` lines: device users upserted (only the fields stated), cache bump `devices:devices`, `devices:device_users`.; Unknown token or mismatching SN: `devices_adms_unknown_device` row created/incremented (quarantine).

**Responses:** 200 HANDSHAKE on cdata: the option block (text/plain). getrequest/ping/registry: `OK`.; 200 `ERROR` (text/plain): per-token throttle exceeded, ingestion failure, a table push > 1 MiB, or the request could not be recorded — the terminal retries.; 404 Flag `ADMS_RECEIVER` is off.

**POST cdata** with `table=`: ATTLOG lines `PIN<TAB>YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS<TAB>status<TAB>verify<TAB>workcode<TAB>reserved` → punches, reply `OK: <received>` (unparsable lines counted invalid). USERINFO lines `PIN=..<TAB>Name=..<TAB>Pri=..<TAB>Passwd=..<TAB>Card=..<TAB>Grp=..` and OPERLOG `USER PIN=..` lines → device users, reply `OK: <lines>`. Authentication is the secret token in the path **and** the `SN` the request states: they must belong to the same device, which must be active, `adms_enabled` and (if it has an allow-list) pushing from an allowed IP. Every reply is HTTP 200 `text/plain; charset=utf-8` with explicit Content-Length. Every request is recorded as evidence (`devices_adms_request`, token redacted). No SN → `OK`, evidence only; unknown token or SN not matching the token → `OK`, serial quarantined (UNKNOWN_SERIAL/TOKEN_MISMATCH), nothing ingested; refused device → `OK`, evidence only. Throttled per token (`iclock` 300/min): beyond it the reply is `ERROR` and nothing is recorded. A failure inside the server answers `ERROR` so the terminal resends.

**PUT** is accepted (ALLOWED_METHODS = GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and goes through the same pipeline as POST: on `cdata` without `options=` the `table=` decides (e.g. ATTLOG is ingested); other endpoints are recorded and answered `OK`. Real firmware does not use it. Methods outside GET/POST/PUT/DELETE (PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS…) get `OK` without being recorded.

**Auth:** `device_token` — Token in the path + matching `SN` query param (serial AND token). No header auth; CSRF-exempt. Throttle `iclock` 300/min per token (reply `ERROR`). Flag `ADMS_RECEIVER`.

**Flag:** `ADMS_RECEIVER` must be enabled (404 otherwise).

**Path params:** `device_token` (str) ← `{{iclock_device_token}}` — The per-device push token issued (shown once) by POST /api/v1/devices/{uid}/adms/enable/. Only its sha256 is stored; ≤ 128 chars.; `endpoint` (str) ← `{{iclock_known_endpoint}}` — Firmware endpoint: cdata (handshake on GET / table push on POST), getrequest (command poll), devicecmd (command result), registry, ping. `.aspx` suffix and trailing slash are optional (`cdata.aspx`, `cdata/`). choices: cdata, getrequest, devicecmd, registry, ping

**Side effects:** Evidence row in `devices_adms_request` for every request (body ≤ 1 MiB stored, passwords/templates redacted, ATTPHOTO/BIODATA never stored; purged after 30 days).; Admitted request: device ADMS contact counters/timestamps updated (handshake → REGISTERED; getrequest → last command poll; table push → last push).; HANDSHAKE: device `adms_options` stored; a label-registered device adopts the stated serial (identity VERIFIED).; ATTLOG: punches ingested through the shared ingestion (content dedup with agent uploads), SyncLog ATTENDANCE, outbox `attendance.punches_ingested` when new.; USERINFO / OPERLOG `USER` lines: device users upserted (only the fields stated), cache bump `devices:devices`, `devices:device_users`.; Unknown token or mismatching SN: `devices_adms_unknown_device` row created/incremented (quarantine).

**Responses:** 200 Same replies as POST (`OK: <n>` for an ATTLOG push, `OK` otherwise).; 200 `ERROR` (text/plain): per-token throttle exceeded, ingestion failure, a table push > 1 MiB, or the request could not be recorded — the terminal retries.; 404 Flag `ADMS_RECEIVER` is off.

request.description:
ZKTeco/eSSL ADMS push receiver (plain Django view, CSRF-exempt, outside DRF). Gated by flag `ADMS_RECEIVER` (404 JSON `not_found` while off). Authentication is the secret token in the path **and** the `SN` the request states: they must belong to the same device, which must be active, `adms_enabled` and (if it has an allow-list) pushing from an allowed IP. Every reply is HTTP 200 `text/plain; charset=utf-8` with explicit Content-Length. Every request is recorded as evidence (`devices_adms_request`, token redacted). No SN → `OK`, evidence only; unknown token or SN not matching the token → `OK`, serial quarantined (UNKNOWN_SERIAL/TOKEN_MISMATCH), nothing ingested; refused device → `OK`, evidence only. Throttled per token (`iclock` 300/min): beyond it the reply is `ERROR` and nothing is recorded. A failure inside the server answers `ERROR` so the terminal resends.

**Catch-all** `^(?P<endpoint>.*)$`: any other path under `/iclock/<token>/` (e.g. `querydata`, `rtdata`, `fdata`, or a nested path) reaches the same receiver. The endpoint name is classified by substring (`cdata`, `getrequest`, `devicecmd`, `registry`, `ping` anywhere in it behave like the named endpoint); anything else is recorded as kind UNKNOWN and answered `OK` — never rejected, so unfamiliar firmware does not retry forever. An admitted UNKNOWN request still counts as contact from the terminal. Methods outside GET/POST/PUT/DELETE get `OK` unrecorded.

**Auth:** `device_token` — Token in the path + matching `SN` query param (serial AND token). No header auth; CSRF-exempt. Throttle `iclock` 300/min per token (reply `ERROR`). Flag `ADMS_RECEIVER`.

**Flag:** `ADMS_RECEIVER` must be enabled (404 otherwise).

**Path params:** `device_token` (str) ← `{{iclock_device_token}}` — The per-device push token issued (shown once) by POST /api/v1/devices/{uid}/adms/enable/. Only its sha256 is stored; ≤ 128 chars.; `endpoint` (str) ← `{{iclock_endpoint}}` — Any path not matched by the named endpoints (e.g. `querydata`, `rtdata`, `something/else`). Recorded with request_kind UNKNOWN.

**Side effects:** Evidence row in `devices_adms_request` (request_kind UNKNOWN, body ≤ 1 MiB, passwords/templates redacted).; Admitted request: device ADMS contact counters updated.; Unknown token or mismatching SN: serial quarantined in `devices_adms_unknown_device`.

**Responses:** 200 `OK` (recorded as UNKNOWN).; 200 `ERROR` (text/plain): per-token throttle exceeded, ingestion failure, a table push > 1 MiB, or the request could not be recorded — the terminal retries.; 404 Flag `ADMS_RECEIVER` is off.

request.description:
Old `POST /api/verify-otp/` → `leads.services.otp.verify_code`; an approved code also records the enquiry as a lead (form QUOTE_REQUEST, page `/advanced-calculator`), as the legacy `record_lead` did. A repeat number (imported `sent_quotes` row or an earlier quote enquiry) answers "We already have your details!" without `quote_id`; otherwise `quote_id` = `QUOTE_<8 hex of the lead uid>` (no quotations row is written). Wrong/expired code → 400 `{error}`; too many wrong codes → 429 legacy body. The code comes from `send-otp` (SMS). nginx (shim mode) rewrites the old URL `/api/verify-otp/` to this path; the response is the OLD contract, byte-compatible with the legacy server (docs/decisions/legacy-shim.md).

**Auth:** `none` — Anonymous (no authentication classes, AllowAny). Throttle: custom throttles `otp` (5/10min per normalised `phone_number`; un-normalisable → client-IP bucket; separate buckets for send and verify) + `otp_ip` (20/10min per client IP). Flag LEGACY_API_SHIM (off → 404). Not in the OpenAPI schema (schema = None; DV-131).

**Flag:** `LEGACY_API_SHIM` must be enabled (404 otherwise).

**Body fields:** `phone_number`* string; `code`* string; `name` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Twilio Verify check; OtpRequest verified + audit `leads.otp_verified`; Lead row (QUOTE_REQUEST) → audit `leads.lead_created`, outbox `leads.created`, cache bump `leads`

**Responses:** 200 Approved (first request).; 400 Bare serializer errors, or `{error}` (`The code is not correct.`, `This code has expired or was never sent. Request a new code.`).; 429 Per-phone `otp` / per-IP `otp_ip` throttle, daily send cap (10/24 h) or too many wrong codes: the legacy rate-limit body (W-1) with `Retry-After` when throttled.; 503 OTP provider unavailable.; 404 LEGACY_API_SHIM off: the platform's plain 404 (as for an unrouted path).

**Flag:** `LEGACY_API_SHIM` must be enabled (404 otherwise).

**Body fields:** `full_name`* string; `phone`* string; `email`* string; `profession`* string [Real Estate Agent, Builder / Developer, Influencer / Content Creator, Financial Advisor, Freelancer / Gig Worker, Society / RWA Representative, Other]; `district`* string [Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Pathanamthitta, Alappuzha, Kottayam, Idukki, Ernakulam, Thrissur, Palakkad, Malappuram, Kozhikode, Wayanad, Kannur, Kasaragod]; `website` string  (* required)

request.description:
Old `POST /api/job-applications/` (multipart/form-data or form-urlencoded only) → canonical `PublicJobApplicationSerializer` + `careers.services.applications.submit_application`. `position_id` is the legacy integer id (from studio-api job-positions `data[].id`; unknown → 400 `Invalid pk "…" - object does not exist.`); the posting must still be published. `resume` (PDF/DOC/DOCX ≤ 10 MB, type checked from content) is required, `declaration_accepted` must be true; HTML-form rules (empty optional = default, missing checkbox = false). Honeypot `website` must be empty. nginx (shim mode) rewrites the old URL `/api/job-applications/` to this path; the response is the OLD contract, byte-compatible with the legacy server (docs/decisions/legacy-shim.md). `position_id` (optional) is the LEGACY integer id of a posting, resolved through `core.LegacyMap` (`legacy/services/forms.py` `_position_uid`); it is left out of the example (a general application) because ids only exist for imported postings — an unknown id answers 400 `{"position_id": ["Invalid pk ..."]}`.

**Auth:** `none` — Anonymous (no authentication classes, AllowAny). Throttle: `public_write` (20/min per client IP). Flag LEGACY_API_SHIM (off → 404). Not in the OpenAPI schema (schema = None; DV-131).

**Flag:** `LEGACY_API_SHIM` must be enabled (404 otherwise).

**Body fields:** `position` string; `position_id` integer; `position_title` string; `department_name` string; `full_name`* string; `email`* string; `phone`* string; `location`* string; `linkedin`* string; `portfolio_website` string; `current_company` string; `current_role` string; `total_experience` string [0–1 years, 1–3 years, 3–5 years, 5+ years]; `relevant_experience` string [0–1 years, 1–3 years, 3–5 years, 5+ years]; `current_salary` string [Below ₹3 LPA, ₹3–5 LPA, ₹5–8 LPA, ₹8–12 LPA, ₹12+ LPA]; `expected_salary` string [Below ₹3 LPA, ₹3–5 LPA, ₹5–8 LPA, ₹8–12 LPA, ₹12+ LPA]; `notice_period` string [Immediate, 15 days, 1 month, 2 months, 3 months]; `heard_about_us` string [LinkedIn, Job Portal, Referral, Company Website, Social Media, Other]; `availability` string; `cover_note` string; `resume`* file; `portfolio_file` file; `declaration_accepted`* boolean; `website` string  (* required)

**Side effects:** Résumé/portfolio stored as private media assets (discarded on failure); JobApplication row + RECEIVED event, audit `careers.application_received`; outbox `careers.application_received`

**Responses:** 201 Application received (legacy shape; file fields are null).; 400 Validation failed (legacy field names).; 415 A JSON body (only multipart / form-urlencoded parsers).; 429 Throttled: DRF's default body (as the legacy DRF server answered).; 404 LEGACY_API_SHIM off: the platform's plain 404 (as for an unrouted path).

Plain Django view (no auth, no throttle, `Cache-Control: no-cache` via `never_cache`) polled by the VM cron and the deploy script. Runs every registered check: `database`, `cache` (critical) and `outbox`, `render_queue`, `audit_partitions` (non-critical). `status` is `ok` (all pass), `degraded` (only non-critical checks fail — still HTTP 200) or `fail` (a critical check failed — HTTP 503). A check that raises is reported with `error` (exception class name). Only GET/HEAD; other methods answer 405 `method_not_allowed`.

**Auth:** `none` — Unauthenticated, unthrottled.

**Responses:** 200 `ok` or `degraded`.; 405 `method_not_allowed` for anything but GET/HEAD (`Allow: GET, HEAD`).; 503 `status: fail` — a critical check (database, cache) failed; same body shape.
